out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WRITE THE DATE THAT THE LAST PIECE WAS SOLD ON THE CORRESPONDING TAG. RETAIN FOR 90 DAYS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) cooked whole beets; 2) cooked onions; 3) jalapeño suace
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: tray of glasses were observed being washed in the small chemical dish washer. When tested with a chlorine test strip, no color change was observed indicating the presence of no chlorine in the small dish washer.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. TRAY OF GLASSES WERE CLEANED AND SANITIZED IN THE LARGE DISH WASHER. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE THE LARGE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE TO WASH AND SANITIZE THE GLASSES UNTIL THE SMALL CHEMICAL MACHINE IS REPAIRED. PIC CALLED IN-HOUSE MAINTENANCE DURING THE INSPECTION. MAINTENANCE WILL ORDER A PART TO REPLACE A BROKE PART.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: small chemical dish washer
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THIS DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED.
